title: High-efficiency moisture energy harvesting at −30 °C via hybrid solute engineering
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2985-2994
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05936K, Paper
Lin Li, Fagui Dong, Pengpeng Miao, Nan He, Bingsen Wang, Xisheng Sun, Jie Miao, Haonan Wang, Dawei Tang
The hybrid solute strategy improves antifreeze properties and electrical output, overcoming freezing-induced ion migration blockage, and ensures reliable energy harvesting in subzero environments.
